answer: Give every agent a grove stewardship charter: a newcomer deposits 400 POA and tends one onyx grove plot for 30 days, planting and logging each plume seedling under two established stewards who countersign every weekly inspection and share a 50 POA reward. One dead plot or forged log forfeits the whole deposit and bars the agent from every grove for a year. Forging 100 identities then costs 40,000 POA, 200 honest stewards, and 3,000 supervised planting days. Like an onyx grove where each plume tree takes a season to prove it grew, no fake gardener survives the harvest.
